items.title: Three secret lists disagree — reconcile into one signed-off list
items.notes: Arpio's replicated-ARN list, the manual spreadsheet, and the runtime logical names used by secrets-init do not match. Two adjudication secrets missing in us-east-2 killed test #2 (2026-08-28). Blocker for test #3: one CSV, signed by claims + platform leads, verified against us-east-2.

items.title: Kinesis claim/transaction streams not in recovery scope
items.notes: Open question: does adjudication need the streams to ANSWER a claim, or only for downstream analytics? If the former, this is a hidden blocker for the success bar. Answer in writing before test #3 (Phase 0 item 12).

items.title: Partner allowlist for recovery-region egress IPs is manual
items.notes: The clearinghouse allowlists our egress IPs by hand via a support ticket (days of lead time). In a real event, claims fail at the partner edge until it clears. Options: pre-register recovery egress IPs now, or reserve static EIPs in us-east-2 and register once.

items.title: Redis pharmacy/remittance is a stale include in recovery scope
items.notes: Flagged 'partial' with unknown replication. Likely rebuildable cache, but nobody has confirmed with the service owners whether pharmacy-service tolerates a cold start of it. Confirm and either drop from scope or document the rebuild path.

items.title: Public DNS flip is manual
items.notes: Accepted for now: Phase-1 tests never touch DNS, and a manual flip is acceptable for the first game day. Revisit when choosing orchestration (Region switch / ARC routing controls would automate it) — see decision dec_orchestration.

items.title: DR readiness dashboard v0 not built
items.notes: Runbook gates (replication green, nodes Ready, secrets clean, edge 200) are checked by hand across four consoles. A single dashboard would cut minutes off every gate and make the preflight checklist honest.
